metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Joshua Oliphant for productivity and learning workflows

plugins.name: mochi-creator
plugins.description: Create evidence-based spaced repetition flashcards using cognitive science principles. Applies the 5 properties of effective prompts for long-term retention.

plugins.name: autonomous-sdlc
plugins.description: Autonomous SDLC as a state machine on disk driven by a Stop-hook loop (optionally a user-armed /goal) — one verified unit of work per iteration, decide-log-proceed autonomy, built-in verify/code-review/simplify gates

plugins.name: hexagonal-agents
plugins.description: Build web apps where an AI agent dynamically generates HTML UI using hexagonal architecture with HTMX

plugins.name: compound-knowledge
plugins.description: Capture solved problems, retrieve past solutions, and graduate accumulated knowledge into living context. Skills: compound-capture, compound-retrieve, compound-graduate.

plugins.name: autoloop
plugins.description: Generate autonomous experiment loops with immutable runner scripts, tiered quality gates, secondary metrics, and structured METRIC output.

plugins.name: observability-harness
plugins.description: Install a local, Docker-free OTLP observability stack (OpenTelemetry → Vector → JSONL, optionally VictoriaLogs + VictoriaMetrics) into a project and instrument the code, with a scan-and-propose step for domain-appropriate spans and metrics — then query that telemetry as a development feedback signal (observability-query skill, status --json contract, scripted end-to-end verify).

plugins.name: understand
plugins.description: Process information for real understanding with the explain-back skill: explain from memory, grade against the real source, struggle-then-teach per gap, output Mochi cards and a resumable session record. An antidote to the illusion of clarity.

plugins.name: review-diff
plugins.description: Local web-based diff review — comment on your working-tree or committed-branch diff in the browser and feed the comments back to Claude Code

plugins.name: stick-shift
plugins.description: Manually-driven ("disassembled") SDLC: the same .sdlc/ session format as autonomous-sdlc, but you drive each phase by hand via slash commands — /spec → /plan → /build (TDD) → /verify → /journal. Built for legible, narratable live demos.

plugins.name: agent-skills
plugins.description: Small, composable workflow skills for coding agents: docs-first discipline, autonomous execution, cross-agent watchdog and plan arbitration, efficient model orchestration, clear status recaps, usage-limit awareness, and local self-contained HTML visual plan/recap modes.
